intro: Welcome to Samsun Museum, a museum in Samsun province, opened in 1980. It is known for the Hellenistic gold hoard lifted from the Amisos tumulus, and it holds the Early Bronze Age finds of the İkiztepe excavation.
history: The museum opened in 1980, and its best known treasure is the Hellenistic gold hoard found in the Amisos tumulus in 1995. The collection also holds the Early Bronze Age finds of the İkiztepe excavation near Bafra, along with Roman mosaics.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the Amisos gold hoard and the finds from İkiztepe. Take in the Roman mosaics, and visit the Ethnography hall.
facts: Did you know? Among the bronze tools from İkiztepe are surgical blades, evidence that operations were being performed on this coast in the third millennium BC. And the Hellenistic gold hoard found in the Amisos tumulus in 1995 is the best known part of the museum.
outro: This brings our visit to Samsun Museum to an end. Before you go, a small request: please leave the objects untouched and take your photographs without flash. These objects have survived for millennia; let them keep their story for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
